insight: Announced at the 2024 Data + AI Summit and made generally available to Databricks SQL customers in 2025.
name: Databricks AI/BI Genie
tagline: Conversational analytics over your Databricks lakehouse data.
description: A no-code conversational analytics interface within the Databricks platform. Business users ask plain-English questions about lakehouse data and Genie returns SQL, charts, and natural-language explanations. It adapts to your business concepts and enforces Unity Catalog governance, so answers stay secure and auditable. Billed through Databricks compute rather than a separate license.

modelSupport.notes: Generative AI over the lakehouse; usage billed as LLM DBUs under the pay-as-you-go model.

edge: No separate license fee; rides the lakehouse and inherits Unity Catalog permissions so answers stay governed.
